_comment: Plan 0032 objective 3: how much airborne lift does it take to route around the crossing? Sweeps the per-turn airborne battalion cap (0 = the mechanic present but grounded, 7 = the USER-dialled default, 14 = double). Held against the ONE configuration where the defender is not already losing every game: 12 ROC reserve brigades in mobilization (plan 0029's strongest defender-side lever, which takes Red to 83.3%). Green is roc_defense, Red is air_assault (selfplay_default's ground play plus the airborne doctrine), so cell 0 is the no-lift reference and every rise is attributable to the air path alone.
